description.label: Description
description.value:
Minor Mental Mutation

Your heart has grown cold and hard. You're no longer able to bring yourself to care about the feelings and wellbeing of others. You still have feelings, just not for anyone but yourself. Hence you are self-centred and view things from the lens of what you want from the world. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.mqo51ORnxijcqNNu]{Frightening} Talent. Your interest in others ranges from indifferent to cruel, and you don’t really care about the wellbeing or dignity of others - things break and people die. You gain +10 on Tests to hurt or exploit the weaknesses of other people, and -10 on Tests of helping or showing kindness towards others. You cannot gain this mutation if you are already @UUID[Compendium.artantares-mutations.items.Item.dh1S3eHhUFMqQa1Z]{Soft-hearted}.
